title_en: At Sofie Residence, 1+1 Fully Furnished Apartment for Sale!!!

The apartment has a gross surface of 75 m2, net 62 m2 and is located on the 1st floor of one of the buildings of the complex. The residence is perfect for living, it has ample spaces, there is private security and maximum security in the residence. The apartment comes with 2 parking spaces at a price of 50,000 euros. Sofie Residence brings a harmony between modern architecture and nature, creating an oasis of calm, elegance and comfort. Surrounded by greenery and characterized by contemporary design, this residential complex offers carefully curated spaces and premium facilities, being the ideal choice for those who appreciate style, quality and harmony in every aspect of living.
